title: 第23章 墓前祭奠练拳招第24章 超大气血丸村里浓烟滚滚出事了
slug: 聚灵飞升第1126章暗流之下
content_zh:
鸡鸣山道观后山，一处背风之地。
这里是老道爷的坟墓。
是他老人家生前自己选的地方。
云昊来到老道爷的坟前，带着一些祭品，一一摆放好。
有一些糖果，白面馒头，还特意从品味酒楼打了一壶酒。
老道爷以前很喜欢喝酒，只是没钱买，云昊的记忆中，老道爷偶去镇上会打一壶酒，能喝很长很长时间。
后来他才知道，是往里面掺水了。
用老道爷的话说，解个馋就行，等以后他要是修道有成，一定要喝上一壶没有掺水的好酒。
可惜，到死，老道爷都没有修道修出眉目，好酒也没喝上。
点燃了三炷香，云昊认真磕了三个头。
拿起酒壶，倒出来香气四溢的美酒，开口说道：“老道爷，我请你喝酒，这是镇上最大酒楼，品味酒楼罗浮春，一壶八百钱呢，我专门给你买的。
你慢慢品，这玩意喝着辛辣，我喝不惯，也不知道你为什么喜欢喝……反正，我现在有钱了，以后还给你买，你到了下面也不知道过的怎么样，有没有挨饿呢？
今天还给你买了大白面馒头，你也尝尝……老道爷我想你了，你在下面好好过日子，哦还有啊，你留下的修道书籍我没烧。
因为我发现我能修，也不知道最终会不会修成你说的那种飞天遁地的仙人，反正我试试看，就当我帮你完成遗愿。
我从金掌柜那里买了一本没有心法只有招式的拳谱，叫《龙象拳》准备练练呢，要是能练成，就做个江湖大侠，嘿嘿，到时候我就去行侠仗义……”
云昊自顾自对着老道爷的坟头说着话，想什么说什么，眼睛也微微发红湿润。
在这个世上除了早逝的爹娘，还有姐姐之外，老道爷对他最好，爷俩也是经常在一起没大没小，不拘小节，可以说他的童年很多时候都是老道爷陪伴度过的。
“好了，我去练拳去，你继续喝吧，等我练好武，还要保护姐姐呢！”
云昊说了一会儿话后，起身去了地头一处平坦之地。
拿出了龙象拳谱翻开。

按照金满堂的话说，这部《龙象拳谱》只有招式没有心法。
对他来说，无所谓。
就从招式开始练。
这段时间接触的云河和流云武馆的那些人，都是懂武功招式的。
打架的时候，自己靠的是一身的蛮力。
而招式，在云昊看来是技巧。
如果自己也有武功招式技巧，那么加上体内小腹中的气流力量贯通全身，再对上那些武夫，就能轻而易举战胜。
另外还有个危机感是，金满堂说听到消息，自己打了流云武馆那些人，流云武馆明面上不会报复，但暗地里一定会。
不得不小心。
他算是明白，这个世道，拳头硬，才不被人欺负。
也是活下去的资本。
总之自身强大才是。
且不说流云武馆这种要提防的暗箭。
就说他每次去镇上，都会被人盯上，当成肥羊，半路打劫。
要不是自己喝了宝瓶水，吃了宝瓶水种出来的大米饭，力量足够大，早就被人打死了。
content_en:
The mountain behind the Taoist temple in Jiming Mountain is a place leeward.
This is the grave of the old Taoist.
It was the place he chose himself when he was alive.
Yunhao came to the old Taoist's grave, brought some sacrifices, and placed them one by one.
There were some candies, white-flour steamed buns, and a glass of wine from the Tasting Restaurant.
The old Taoist used to like drinking, but he didn't have the money to buy it. In Yunhao's memory, the old Taoist would buy a pot of wine when he went to town, and he could drink it for a long time.
Later he found out that water had been added to it.
In the words of the old Taoist master, it is enough to satisfy his greed. If he succeeds in cultivating Taoism in the future, he must drink a pot of good wine without water.
It's a pity that until his death, the old Taoist master had not cultivated his Taoism and had no talent for cultivation, nor could he drink any good wine.
After lighting three sticks of incense, Yun Hao kowtowed three times seriously.
He picked up the jug, poured out the fragrant wine, and said, "Old Taoist, let me treat you to a drink. This is the largest restaurant in the town, Tasting Restaurant Luofuchun. A jug costs 800 yuan. I bought it specially for you.
You taste it slowly, this stuff is spicy, I can't get used to it, and I don't know why you like it... Anyway, I have money now, and I will buy it for you in the future. I don't know how you are doing when you get down there. Are you hungry?
I also bought you a big white flour steamed bun today, you should try it too... I miss you, old Taoist master. You live a good life down there. Oh, and ah, I didn’t burn the Taoist books you left behind.
Because I discovered that I can cultivate, and I don’t know if I will eventually become the kind of immortal you mentioned that can fly into the sky and escape from the earth. Anyway, I will give it a try and treat it as me helping you fulfill your last wish.
I bought a boxing manual from Shopkeeper Jin, which has no mental techniques but only moves. It’s called "Dragon Elephant Boxing" and I’m going to practice it. If I can master it, I will become a martial arts hero. Hehe, then I will go out to do justice..."
Yunhao was talking to the old Taoist's grave by himself, saying whatever he was thinking, and his eyes were slightly red and moist.
In this world, apart from his father, mother, and sister who died young, the old Taoist was the best to him. The two of them were often together, no matter how old or young, and they didn't stick to trivial matters. It can be said that he spent a lot of his childhood with the old Taoist.
"Okay, I'm going to practice boxing. You can keep drinking. When I finish practicing martial arts, I still have to protect my sister!"
After Yunhao spoke for a while, he got up and went to a flat place at the end of the field.
He took out the Dragon Elephant Boxing Manual and opened it.
According to Jin Mantang, this "Dragon Elephant Boxing Book" only has moves but no mental techniques.
To him, it doesn't matter.
Just start practicing from the moves.
The people at Yunhe and Liuyun Martial Arts Schools that I came into contact with during this period all knew martial arts moves.
When fighting, he relies on his brute strength.
In Yunhao's opinion, moves are skills.
If you also have martial arts skills, and the power of the air flow in your lower abdomen penetrates your whole body, you can easily defeat those martial artists.
There is also a sense of crisis. Jin Mantang said that after hearing the news, he beat up the people at Liuyun Martial Arts School. Liuyun Martial Arts School would not retaliate on the surface, but it would definitely do so secretly.
Have to be careful.
He finally understood that in this world, only by having a strong fist would you not be bullied.
It is also the capital to survive.
In short, it is the strength of oneself.
Not to mention the hidden arrows like Liuyun Martial Arts School that we should beware of.
Just say that every time he goes to town, he will be targeted, treated as a fat sheep, and robbed along the way.
If he hadn't drank the Aquarius Water and ate the rice grown from the Aquarius Water, he would have been beaten to death long ago.
